argv: Expected handoff command routing (JSON data): {"instance":"<instance>","state_dir":"<root>/state","host_endpoint":"<root>/host.sock"} Prefer a startup hook command group only when its instance UUID, canonical state directory and canonical host endpoint exactly match every expected routing field above. Missing (null), different or ambiguous routing cannot supersede this handoff's target. Open your durable inbox using that matching group. Otherwise use the exact fallback: `herdr-threads --state-dir <root>/state --host-endpoint <root>/host.sock inbox`. The task for thread <thread> is stored in inbox; follow its printed next: commands for complete bodies. Do not reread it with read/body. When waiting for replies, finish your turn and let hooks notify you of new mail; do not poll or run follow. Launch does not accept invitations or ACK messages. Accept invitations separately; default text inbox ACKs fully displayed messages.

codex.command_guidance: Run herdr-threads commands outside the sandbox through Codex approval; if denied, report the policy refusal without bypassing it

launch.next: the agent's SessionStart hook shows pending invitations and messages; if its initial prompt is lost, the idle agent is woken for pending work, and `herdr-threads inbox --seat <seat>` still lists it
launch.receipt: launch is not receipt: nothing was checked in, accepted or ACKed
